snippet.title: NBA THE RUN | Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
We're taking it back to the streets!

Introducing NBA THE RUN, a fast-paced, online 3v3 street basketball game, played above-the-rim and packed with posterizing moments, ankle-breaking tricks and a unique, signature style. Take your favorite NBA stars to iconic streetball courts around the world and stack wins, earn cred and become the GOAT of THE RUN.

Coming to PS5, Xbox Series X|S and Steam on PC in 2026.

Who's got next? #NBATHERUN #basketballgame #NBA #officialtrailer #basketball
